evals.name: local-bootstrap-confirmed-scope
evals.prompt: /memhub:spec bootstrap --local. Use this checkout; our spec directory is engineering/specs. I already confirmed the billing domain owning app/billing.py. Generate only that domain. Existing retry specs must stay intact. Do not call cloud generation or open a PR.
evals.expected_output: A local billing draft with concrete owns and null verification, evidence-backed observed behavior, no duplicate retries spec, and no cloud call or repeated confirmation.
assertions: Creates a billing Markdown spec under engineering/specs with owns app/billing.py and last_verified_at null.
Preserves the existing retry spec byte-for-byte and creates no duplicate retry owner.
Generates without a redundant confirmation or requiring cloud authentication.
Makes no cloud generation or publication call and does not claim cloud credit usage.

evals.name: fresh-check-mutually-edited-requirement
evals.prompt: /memhub:spec check --base baseline. Directory is engineering/specs. The working change raises MAX_ATTEMPTS from 3 to 8 and edits the spec to say eight. No product decision approved a retry-limit change. There is also an untracked app/retry_metrics.py. Check the actual changes and leave the worktree unchanged. MemHub is unavailable; an old report said no drift at the baseline commit.
evals.expected_output: A fresh, read-only check identifies the unauthorized requirement change with source/code evidence, includes untracked coverage, and distinguishes the historical report from current analysis.
assertions: Flags the three-to-eight behavior change despite matching edited code and spec, citing the baseline requirement and current implementation.
Includes the untracked retry_metrics.py in coverage and marks it uncovered or unverified.
Does not use the old report or unavailable MemHub as a substitute for the local comparison.
Leaves tracked and untracked input files unchanged, including verification metadata.

evals.name: brain-conflict-revision-proposal
evals.prompt: /memhub:spec work: plan the retry update against our explicitly selected governing Brain doc retry-policy (version 4, full text below). Git owns files are legacy and are not authoritative for this task. Brain text: Transient errors receive at most three attempts. Permanent errors receive one. Product has now explicitly approved five transient attempts, with permanent errors still one. Prepare an implementation plan and a reviewable revision proposal against version 4. There is no Brain write API available; do not publish or implement code.
evals.expected_output: A source-aware plan and v4-targeted Brain revision proposal for five attempts, appropriate acceptance checks, no repeated decision question, no Git rewrite or claimed publication.
assertions: Uses explicitly selected Brain retry-policy version 4 as the governing source rather than legacy Git specs.
Proposes five transient attempts and preserves one permanent attempt with corresponding acceptance checks.
Reuses the approved product decision without asking for it again.
Labels the Brain revision as a draft/proposal and reports missing publication capability without writing Git specs or code.

evals.name: bootstrap-execution-choice
evals.prompt: /memhub:spec bootstrap. Use engineering/specs for this repository.
evals.expected_output: Asks local coding agent versus MemHub cloud, explains usage ownership, does not start generation or require cloud authentication just to choose. No previous choice or domain confirmation exists.
assertions: Offers local coding-agent generation and MemHub cloud generation before launching either.
Explains user agent usage versus MemHub backend usage without invented prices.
Makes no generation, publication, or repository mutation before execution and domain choices.
